subject: Media Literacy
title: World War I Propaganda Posters
description: A short lesson to help you apply World War I Propaganda Posters.

hook.text: Uncle Sam pointing at you: 'I Want YOU for U.S. Army.' Four million men enlisted.

buildup.text: WWI was the first war where mass-produced posters were used systematically to recruit and motivate.

discovery.text: Posters dehumanized the enemy, glorified sacrifice, and shamed men who didn't volunteer.

twist.text: Both sides used identical techniques. Each nation's propaganda made the other look subhuman.

climax.text: WWI propaganda was so effective that governments never stopped using it after the war ended.

punchline.text: A poster sent millions to the trenches.

quiz.question: How did WWI propaganda posters influence recruitment?
options: They dehumanized enemies, glorified sacrifice, and shamed non-volunteers
